# SWT3 AI Witness Protocol
# https://tenova.io

> SWT3 is a cryptographic accountability protocol for AI systems. It provides
> independent, deterministic witness anchors that prove AI governance compliance
> across 36 regulatory frameworks including EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, CMMC, and
> SR 11-7. Think of it as TLS certificates for AI accountability.

## What SWT3 Does

SWT3 mints cryptographic attestation records (witness anchors) for every AI
inference, governance decision, tool access, and agent handoff. These anchors
are independently verifiable and provide non-repudiation evidence for auditors,
regulators, and assessors.

## SDKs (all Apache-2.0)

- Python: pip install swt3-ai
- TypeScript: npm install @tenova/swt3-ai
- MCP Server: npm install @tenova/swt3-mcp (33 tools, Witness Middleware, works with Claude, ChatGPT, etc.)
- Go: go get github.com/tenova-labs/swt3-ai-go
- Rust: cargo add swt3-ai
- C#: dotnet add package swt3-ai
- Ruby: gem install swt3-ai
- Swift: Swift Package Manager (github.com/tenova-labs/swt3-ai-swift)
- Kotlin: Maven Central (io.tenova:swt3-ai)

## Regulatory Frameworks Covered

EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, NIST 800-53, NIST 800-171, CMMC v2.0, FedRAMP,
SR 11-7, ISO 42001, GPAI Code of Practice, OWASP Agentic Top 10,
Five Eyes Agentic AI, NIS 2 Directive, GDPR, DORA, and 20 more.
